hypothesis: Residual coordinate sign improves fixed-budget classification after matched end-to-end adaptation, beyond unsigned coordinate magnitudes.
alternative: Sign is redundant after LoRA/head adaptation; frozen-probe differences can reflect calibration or limited adaptation.
controls: same head dropout RNG per step

evaluation.scope: reused development set; not independent final test

criteria.support: macro delta_ce>=0.02 nat and macro delta_auc>=0.01 and each domain delta_ce>=0

novelty: N01-T01 froze target-selected features and trained linear heads; this pair permits LoRA adaptation with equal norm and head. N02-T01 compared VAE/blur, N05-T01 compares norm decompositions with no abs arm. Signed arm is a paired bridge control, not an independent new method/seed result.
stop: after both terminal checkpoints archived and committed
limits: coordinate sign depends on learned feature basis
LoRA adaptation may change the two feature spaces
original feature branch can compensate; null does not prove absence of sign information
cross-server seed/batch/hardware confounding precludes cross-run causal comparison
